turns.doctor_question: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, what brought me in is that I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. I'm a software developer, and lately... I'll be right in the middle of fixing a rendering bug, and a Slack ping will go off, or I'll notice a color pattern on the screen, or even just hear a siren outside. And it completely pulls me away. I end up getting dragged into a whole new idea before I can even finish typing the line of code I was working on. It's just getting really hard to stay on track.

symptom_reasoning.S002: The patient states they have difficulty sustaining attention, noting they 'can't keep my mind on one thing anymore' and find it hard to stay on track.

symptom_reasoning.S039: The patient reports that their attention is easily drawn to irrelevant external stimuli, causing them to be pulled into new ideas before finishing a task.
symptom_reasoning.S059: The patient describes a clear difficulty in concentrating on their work, stating it is 'getting really hard to stay on track.'
